scope: One four-byte Ada-originated write to an intentionally read-only translated private A2000 BAR1 page.

qualified_result.exact_fault: DMA Write NO_PASID, requester 01:00.0, <BAR1_IOVA>, reason 0x05, PTE Write access is not set

publication.addresses: Run-specific IOVA, physical, BAR and payload values are replaced by stable symbolic tokens.
omitted: GPU UUIDs and full hardware inventories
binaries, kernel modules, initrd and deployment scripts
publication.reproducibility_scope: Offline replay of the sanitized scientific record, not reproduction of the private deployment image.

root_cause_classification.class: asymmetric cross-hierarchy peer-forwarding failure for PEG→TCSS/TBT posted writes, after VT-d ingress
root_cause_classification.confidence: strong for the class, insufficient for a component-level drop point
not_distinguished: USB4 host-router, tunnel or dock forwarding

limitations: The intentional read-only translation proves arrival at VT-d but prevents downstream delivery.
The result covers one four-byte raw C7B5 SYS1 operation and is not a throughput or production transport test.
A CPU write to the same BAR1 page is a host-route control, not P2P.
No physical TLP trace identifies the downstream drop point.
The experiment does not provide a bidirectional P2P fix.
